'''Zosha''' was an uninhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Color/Legends|bluish]] [[Star/Legends|star]]<ref name="TOR" /> in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Zosha system/Legends|Zosha system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> A white-colored celestial body loomed large in Zosha's [[Atmosphere/Legends|sky]], and the planet itself appeared gray, blue, and white from [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="TOR" />

By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="TOR" /> around [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TORcite|type=space|Zosha Advance}} places the [[battle above Zosha]] after the beginning of the [[Galactic War]], which took place in [[3641 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]].</ref> Zosha was situated deep inside the Republic's territory. Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] intercepted the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Scream of Ragnos]]'', the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Javis Koldor]], and its [[Terminus-class destroyer|escort starships]] while the former was rallying [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial vessels]] for a major attack against the Republic. In order to prevent the ''Scream of Ragnos'' from returning to Imperial-controlled space and destroy the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|starship]], Republic forces engaged the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] of the Sith Empire in a [[battle above Zosha]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zosha was introduced in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Zosha [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet, in grid square F-6.<ref name="EAOC" /> Zosha's in-game model<ref name="TOR" /> was also used to depict the Unknown Regions planet [[Vondoru]],<ref name="Vondoru">{{TORcite|type=space|Clouds of Vondoru}}</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> planet [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]],<ref name="Makem Te">{{TORcite|type=space|Makem Te Assault}}</ref> and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="EAOC" /> planet [[Sarapin Four]].<ref name="Sarapin Four">{{TORcite|type=space|Sarapin Assault}}</ref> Similarly, the model was later re-used for<ref name="Hypori">{{TORcite|type=space|Hypori Escort}}</ref><ref name="Lorta">{{TORcite|type=space|Lorta Escort}}</ref> the Outer Rim<ref name="EAOC" /> planet [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]]<ref name="Hypori" /> and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> planet [[Lorta/Legends|Lorta]]<ref name="Lorta" /> in Space Combat missions added to ''The Old Republic'' in<ref name="Hypori" /><ref name="Lorta" /> the [[2012]] Update 1.6.<ref name="Update 1.6 Live">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20121211|text=Game Update 1.6: Ancient Hypergate is Live!}}</ref>
